# LAMMPS input script for Cu quenching simulation

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read initial structure
read_data /structures/task_29/heatedsystem_3000_reax.dat

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy Cu

# Set timestep
timestep 0.001

# Define compute for density
compute density all property/atom mass
compute mass_sum all reduce sum c_density
variable volume equal vol
variable density equal "c_mass_sum/(v_volume*1.0e-24)/6.022e23*63.55"

# Output settings
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density v_density pe ke etotal

# Stage 1: NPT Quenching
fix 1 all npt temp 2000 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 20000
unfix 1

# Stage 2: NPT Relaxation
fix 2 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0
run 10000
unfix 2

# Stage 3: NVT Relaxation
fix 3 all nvt temp 300 300 0.1
run 10000
unfix 3

# Print final density
print "Final_density: ${density}"
